basics.summary: Senior electrical engineering student at the University of Houston, concentrating on computer and embedded systems. I build and test hardware, embedded control systems, digital logic, and electronics interfaces. My experience includes FPGA development, EMI/EMC validation for medical electrodes, avionics sensor-board design, and product marketing engineering at Texas Instruments.
